newsitem.title: USA: Southwest Georgia pays quarterly dividend.
newsitem.headline: Southwest Georgia pays quarterly dividend.

text.p: Southwest Georgia Financial Corp said on Friday that it has declared a $0.10 a share quarterly dividend, an increase in the annual rate from its previously paid semiannual dividend.
The dividend is payable January 31, 1997 to shareholders of record on January 21, the company said.
The company previously paid dividends on a semiannual rate of $0.18 a share on a post split basis. Southwest Georgia said it declared a two-for-one stock split in the fall.
